title: 'barroso_std'
description: 'Standardize Biodiversity Records Across Multiple Fields'
toc: true

---


```{r}
#| eval: false
barRoso::barroso_std()
```

### Description

A wrapper function that performs integrated cleaning and standardization of
biodiversity collection records using the `barRoso` package. This includes
harmonizing taxonomic, geographic, collector, and type status information,
as well as flagging or removing unvouchered and duplicate specimens. Determiner
names in `identifiedBy` are standardized with the same rules of collector names.

### Details

This function orchestrates several std_* functions from the `barRoso`
package to clean records from virtual herbaria and biodiversity portals. It
handles multilingual field names, missing data, inconsistent formatting,
and dataset chunking for large inputs. The function also detects and optionally
removes duplicate records and specimens lacking voucher information.

The final data frame is sorted by species, `recordedBy` and `recordNumber`. All
records of a block of duplicates stay together under the name of the block, which
is the most frequent name among its duplicates. For example, a duplicate identified
as `"Ormosia ruddiana"` goes together with its three duplicates identified as
`"Ormosia amazonica"`, in the place of the latter species.

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| ... | Input data frame containing raw biodiversity records. |
| unvouchered | Logical; if `TRUE`, remove records of wood, seed, fruit, pollen and spirit collections (e.g. `"INPAw"`, `"INPA-Carpoteca"`), and observations without a specimen (`basisOfRecord` like `"HUMAN_OBSERVATION"`) (default: `TRUE`). |
| delunkcoll | Logical; if `TRUE`, removes records with unknown or missing collectors (default: `FALSE`). |
| flag_missid | Reserved for future use. Currently not implemented. |
| flag_duplicates | Logical; if `TRUE`, flags duplicates with a logical column (default: `TRUE`). |
| rm_duplicates | Logical; if `TRUE`, removes duplicate specimens (default: `FALSE`). |
| specialists | Optional character vector of names of specialists, whose identifications are preferred when removing duplicates with conflicting identifications. See `barroso_flag_duplicates()` (default: `NULL`). |
| rm_tied_conflicts | Logical; with `rm_duplicates = TRUE`, if `TRUE`, blocks of duplicates whose conflicting names are equally frequent are removed entirely; if `FALSE`, all their records are kept. See `barroso_flag_duplicates()` (default: `FALSE`). |
| index_herbariorum | Logical; if `TRUE`, checks collection codes against the API of Index Herbariorum, always keeping the original codes. See `std_collection()`. Use `FALSE` to work offline (default: `TRUE`). |
| colname_recordedBy | Column name for collector names. |
| colname_recordNumber | Column name for collector number. |
| colname_identifiedBy | Column name for determiner names. The column is standardized with `std_identifiedBy()` only when present in the data. |
| colname_continent | Column name for continent. |
| colname_country | Column name for country. |
| colname_stateProvince | Column name for state/province. |
| colname_county | Column name for county. |
| colname_municipality | Column name for municipality. |
| colname_locality | Column name for locality. |
| colname_collectionCode | Column name for collection code. |
| colname_institutionCode | Column name for institution code. |
| colname_typeStatus | Column name for type status. |
| colname_family | Column name for family. |
| colname_genus | Column name for genus. |
| colname_specificEpithet | Column name for specific epithet. |
| rm_original_column | Logical; if `TRUE`, remove original columns after standardization, except that of collection codes when `index_herbariorum = TRUE`. |

### Value

A fully cleaned and standardized data frame ready for downstream reconciliation,
duplicate handling, and label generation.

### Examples

```r
df <- read.csv("raw_herbarium_data.csv")
df_std <- barroso_std(df,
                      colname_country = "pais",
                      colname_stateProvince = "estado",
                      rm_duplicates = TRUE)
```
